review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is believed by some people that the rewards should be given to the students who have the best academic results, others say that it is more important to reward students who show improvements. From my perspective, all kind of are worthy for the rewards, regardless the best students or the improvements students.

Admittedly, the rewards for the students who show the best results are right. It can be seen that when the school rewards to the students who have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they can deserve their praises and privileges, which may encourage these students and others to study harder and win the rewards. These activities can lead to propel towards overall academic gains. Furthermore, this kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded, thus students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, students can enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, school should reward the students who have improvements in studies. Only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards. This causes others to think that their efforts is futile, since, they can not surpass those outstanding individuals and prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened. It is naturally follows that, the students may gradually lose the incentive to study. In addition, by emphasizing improvements students, school can encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves, even benefit themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that the rewards should be given to all kind of students, regardless the students who have talented in studies or the students who have improvements. By emphasizing all kind of students, it can help the students to study harder and keep trying in studies.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và kết luận trên nguồn ảnh đủ trang.

review.overall: Em viết đủ bốn phần và chọn thưởng cả hai nhóm, song mức vận dụng câu văn còn yếu. Mở bài 'all kind of are worthy' thiếu danh từ; Body 1 ghép 'These activities can lead to propel' và 'students can enable them' sai khung; Body 2 có 'efforts is futile, since,' và 'by emphasizing improvements students'. Các lỗi nền tảng trải đều nhiều đoạn, khiến người đọc phải đoán quan hệ giữa người được thưởng, nỗ lực và kết quả. Bài làm còn cẩu thả ở khâu ghép câu và tự soát; em cần viết lại theo từng câu đủ chủ–vị, giải thích được vì sao mỗi khung sửa đúng. Em có hai nhánh trong mỗi Body và “Furthermore”, “In addition” đều làm đúng việc mở ý thứ hai. Phần còn thiếu là tín hiệu đưa người đọc từ câu chủ đề sang lý do đầu: “It can be seen that when” và “Only a few...” chưa làm rõ vai trò ấy.
